summary_md: **Sarthak Verma ([@SarthakVeri1g2](https://x.com/SarthakVeri1g2/status/2115067948851470539))** introduces **Stepswitch**, an open-source orchestrator for coding agents on self-hosted models: each step goes to the model that suits it, every change must pass tests and a cross-family review, and README numbers are generated from re-runnable evidence. The thread reports gpt-oss-120b + qwen2.5-32b on one workstation passing 41/42 small-suite tasks, 24/49 on SWE-bench Verified Mini vs 7/49 for mini-SWE-agent, and publicly withdraws three claims that failed confirmation.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - sarthak-1111/stepswitch: An orchestrator for coding agents on local and remote models: each step goes to the model that suits it, every change must pass your tests, and every claim in the README is re-runnable with ssw prove.

relevance: Evidence-first local-model coding harness with candid benchmark reporting.
